narrative.overview: A warm-paper page with confident flat blocks of colour, one oversized wordmark, and photographs Adrian took himself, each captioned with place and year like a note in the margin. It reads as a person's working notebook, not a corporate brochure.
keyCharacteristics: Flat colour fields and 3px rules instead of shadows.
Geist at heavy weight and tight tracking for display; uppercase tracked labels for structure.
Sharp corners everywhere except the photo caption pill.
Light and dark themes; hero always dark.
Real photography and real data only.

rules.name: The One Ember Rule
rules.body: Ember is the only accent. A screen has one dominant ember field at most.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: No pure grey, black or white.

rules.name: The Weight Contrast Rule
rules.body: Heavy (700) against regular reading text; no mid-weight display.

rules.name: The Readable Prose Rule
rules.body: Long-form text uses normal case, 1.5+ line-height and a 65-75ch measure.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never carry shadows. State is shown by colour and translateY.

dos: Do keep every surface flat and square-cornered; use the 3px rule for emphasis.
Do tint all neutrals warm and keep one ember accent.
Do make the CV sympathetic to this system while putting readability first.
donts: Don't add shadows, glows or gradients outside the hero scrim.
Don't introduce a second accent colour.
Don't put long text in uppercase.
Don't let the CV drift back to the legacy Bootstrap look.
